surface: Public runtime surface at react-intersection-observer 10.1.0: useInView, useOnInView, InView, observe, defaultFallbackInView, and test utilities. Upstream case-by-case runtime and type parity evidence remains incomplete.
divergences: Public node and prop types use Octane structural types and do not import React.
InView is implemented as a function component while preserving the upstream render-prop and wrapper behavior.
In TSRX, an InView render function must be supplied through the children prop; nested children compile to an opaque render block.
The vendored upstream runtime and type suites are not yet fully adapted or registered with react-parity:check; see UPSTREAM.md.
ssr: Supported. Observation begins in an effect; initialInView controls deterministic server output.
